context: The November 1 escrow eligibility time passed, but the latest tracker ledger predates eligibility. Separately, main's hourly Cross Analysis workflow committed a generated_at-only sentiment file while both XRP and BTC windows contained zero qualifying observations.
decisions: Treat FinishAfter eligibility, EscrowFinish execution, destination receipt, follow-on movement, EscrowCreate re-lock, exchange deposit and actual sale as separate states.
Require a post-eligibility validated ledger index, raw account_objects and account_tx responses, transaction hashes, tesSUCCESS metadata and affected nodes before asserting execution.
Do not use Bithomp's stale owner-page panels or search-result absence as negative proof.
Do not admit escrow amount or destination movement as a predictive feature until same-ledger corroboration and disposition tracing pass quality checks.
Do not treat generated_at as data freshness. Require qualifying observation count, publication time, ingestion time and source freshness in every feature record.
PR #1435 is the current-main Cross Analysis quarantine proposal: contents:read, checkout credentials disabled, no repository commit/push, six bounded artifacts. It remains draft and unmerged.
Automatic tracked-file and Pages refresh is paused by the proposal; a separate least-privilege publisher must be designed and reviewed before restoration.
Keep all overlapping prior PRs open and unchanged; do not merge stale or overlapping versions without exact-base review and approval.
next_action: Obtain raw validated XRPL account_objects/account_tx after 00:00 UTC; keep PR #1435 unmerged pending approval and continue reviewing the remaining main write-capable workflows.
